Replaced arbitrary startup delay with a bounded acknowledgement and generation check; no coverage threshold changed.

A captured 128 ms source gap hid the table contact; a smooth secant-acceleration test across that gap is unsupported. The configured gap warning now gates that test; held checks remain active. No coefficient changed.

Large packet decoding delayed the synthetic camera itself, sometimes skipping contacts. The final fixture uses an independent paced source process and reports actual rates/gaps; physical assertions retained. Default full output is 50 Hz, with higher cadences measured separately.
Target correctly withheld until the independent synthetic authority renews complete-history evidence. The fixture reports each refresh; no contact is fabricated.

cadence.interpretation: 50 Hz retained as the conservative full-output default. Optional profiles are measured, not universally qualified. Compact source-stamp availability >=95% and <=30 ms publication freshness remain unchanged. CDR rates exclude wire headers.
